{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA rows (999999.99)
qa_rows = (sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)
print("Number of QA rows (revenue == 999999.99):", qa_rows.sum())

# Drop QA rows
sales_clean = sales[~qa_rows]

# Now filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales_clean[
    (sales_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales_clean['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers: {mean_revenue}")"}
